nodes.raw_json: {"step": "S5_normalise", "operatorType": "TR", "contributorGranularity": "cell", "inputArtifacts": ["D6_EnrichedEpisodeData"], "outputArtifacts": ["D7_NormalizedEpisodeData"], "transformations": {"HR_norm": {"derivedFrom": ["HR_res"], "preserveCategories": true, "description": "Min-max normalisation preserves the biometric/health semantics of heart-rate values."}, "EDA_norm": {"derivedFrom": ["EDA_res"], "preserveCategories": true, "description": "Min-max normalisation preserves the biometric/health semantics of EDA values."}, "ACC_norm": {"derivedFrom": ["ACC_res"], "preserveCategories": true, "description": "Min-max normalisation preserves behavioural sensor-data semantics."}, "Id": {"derivedFrom": ["Id"], "preserveCategories": true}, "window_start": {"derivedFrom": ["window_start"], "preserveCategories": true}, "chall_behav": {"derivedFrom": ["chall_behav"], "preserveCategories": true}, "sev": {"derivedFrom": ["sev"], "preserveCategories": true}, "age_grp": {"derivedFrom": ["age_grp"], "preserveCategories": true}, "sex": {"derivedFrom": ["sex"], "preserveCategories": true}, "clinic_site": {"derivedFrom": ["clinic_site"], "preserveCategories": true}, "diag": {"derivedFrom": ["diag"], "preserveCategories": true}}, "globalParameters": {"usesDatasetMinMax": true, "erasureEffect": "recompute_if_minmax_changes", "note": "This policy records the subtle cross-record dependency introduced when min/max parameters are fitted on the full dataset."}, "note": "TR example: numeric values change scale, but privacy semantics of the retained attributes are preserved."}

nodes.raw_json: {"step": "S6_select_modelling_features", "operatorType": "RED", "contributorGranularity": "cell", "inputArtifacts": ["D7_NormalizedEpisodeData"], "outputArtifacts": ["D8_ModellingDataset"], "selectedAttributes": ["HR_norm", "EDA_norm", "ACC_norm", "chall_behav", "sev", "age_grp", "sex"], "removedAttributes": ["Id", "window_start", "clinic_site", "diag"], "riskRemovalRules": [{"condition": "risk_causing_attributes_removed", "removeCategories": ["direct_identifier", "temporal_quasi_identifier", "organisational_context", "reidentification_risk"], "description": "Projection removes the main attributes that caused the prior dataset-level linkage risk; residual quasi-identifiers remain through age group and sex."}], "globalParameters": {"recomputeAccessFromRetainedAttributes": true}, "note": "RED/projection example: output annotation should be computed from retained attributes rather than copied from the whole input dataset."}

nodes.raw_json: {"step": "S8_train_classifier", "operatorType": "LEARN", "contributorGranularity": "record_and_attribute", "inputArtifacts": ["D9_TrainDataset"], "outputArtifacts": ["M1_ChallengingBehaviourClassifier"], "target": "chall_behav", "features": ["HR_norm", "EDA_norm", "ACC_norm", "age_grp", "sex"], "excludedAttributes": ["sev"], "modelExposureMapping": {"biometric": "model_exposed_to_biometric_data", "health": "model_exposed_to_health_data", "behavioural_sensor_data": "model_exposed_to_behavioural_sensor_data", "behavioural_sensitive": "model_exposed_to_behavioural_sensitive_label", "quasi_identifier": "model_exposed_to_quasi_identifier_features"}, "erasureRewrite": {"delete_on_request": "retrain_or_review_on_erasure"}, "mintingRules": [{"condition": "training_set_size_less_than_10", "addCategories": ["small_training_set_model_disclosure_risk"], "description": "Toy model is trained on two records; this rule demonstrates model-specific risk minting."}], "modelAccessRoles": ["DS", "CL", "AU", "DPO"], "note": "LEARN example: input data categories are rewritten into model-exposure categories, and deletion obligations become retraining/review obligations."}
